jobs_results.title: SAP Basis Consultant (5 to 20 Years)
jobs_results.description:
SAP BASIS Consultant | S2R Hiring | Infosys




About the Company:

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation journey. With expertise in cloud, AI, enterprise applications, and digital engineering, Infosys helps organizations accelerate innovation and business growth through cutting-edge technology solutions.




About Role:

We are looking for experienced SAP BASIS Consultants to manage and support SAP landscapes including SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and SAP NetWeaver environments. The role involves SAP administration, upgrades, migrations, system monitoring, performance optimization, and BASIS support for enterprise-wide SAP implementations and transformation programs.




Role Name: SAP BASIS Consultant

Experience: 5-20 Years

Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli

Education: B.Tech/B.E, B.Sc, BCA, Any Post graduation

Work Mode: Hybrid




Roles & Responsibilities

Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP landscapes across multiple environments.Perform SAP installations, upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities.Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.Execute Kernel Upgrades, System Copies, Client Copies, and Transport Management activities.Monitor system health and optimize SAP performance.Manage SAP users, roles, authorizations, and security-related activities.Support Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery activities.Troubleshoot system issues and perform root cause analysis.Collaborate with Infrastructure, Functional, Development, and Cloud teams.Participate in implementation, upgrade, support, and migration projects.


Mandatory Skillset

SAP BASIS Administration, SAP HANA Administration, SAP NetWeaver, SAP S/4HANA, Kernel Upgrade, SAP Installation & Configuration, Transport Management System (TMS), System Copy, Client Copy, Performance Tuning, SAP Monitoring, SAP Security, User Administration, Linux/Unix




Preferred Skillset

SAP S/4HANA Migration, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud Connector, Azure, AWS, GCP, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, HANA Migration




Who Can Apply?

Candidates with hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP S/4HANA, System Copy, Client Copy, Kernel Upgrade, SAP Upgrades, Migrations, Performance Tuning, and SAP Landscape Management.




Who Should NOT Apply?

❌ SAP Security/GRC Profiles

❌ SAP ABAP Developers

❌ SAP Fiori/UI5 Developers

❌ SAP Functional Consultants

❌ SAP MM, SD, FICO, PP, QM, WM Consultants

❌ End User Profiles

❌ Intern/Trainee Profiles

❌ Only Training/Certification Profiles

❌ Candidates with less than 5 years of SAP BASIS experience

❌ Candidates not matching the budget criteria

Bangalore :: E-City Phase 2:: Infosys Limited, No. 40/P-41/P, Gate#: 1, Electronic City Phase-2, Industrial Area, Konappana Agrahara, Bangalore- 560100.

Please find below Job Description for your reference:

Job Location: BengaluruQualification: Any Graduate (Full Time)Experience: 1- 4 YearsNotice Period: Immediate Joiners to 15 daysShift: Flexible to work with any shift (Including Night Shifts)Work Mode: 5 Days Work from OfficeJob Level: 2A/ 3ADesignation: Senior Process Executive/ Process Specialist

Only candidates with international experience are eligible for consideration.


JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A:







Role Summary:

Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs.




Key Responsibilities:




A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle:

Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb).Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs.Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments.Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates.


B. Evidence & Documentation:

Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts.Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready.


C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication:

Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly.Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications).


D. Compliance & Controls:

Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance.Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics.


E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement:

Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health.Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies).Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions.


Required Qualifications:

1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover.Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration).Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE.Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools.Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case.High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote).


Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight.Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices.Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus.Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention.Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce.


JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A:




Role Summary:

Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases.




Key Responsibilities:




A. Complex Case Leadership:

Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code.Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts.


B. Rule Interpretation & Governance:

Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations.Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations.


C. Quality & Enablement:

Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects.Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements.


D. Prevention & Analytics:

Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS).Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload.


Required Qualifications:

Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing.Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred.Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes.

jobs_results.title: Senior Product Analyst - Finance Accounting & Master Data
jobs_results.job_title: Senior Product Analyst - Finance Accounting & Master Data
jobs_results.description:
Senior Product Analyst - Finance Accounting & Master Data




About the Role:




Support the Product Owner by acting as the senior functional bridge between Finance business stakeholders and SAP delivery teams for the Finance Accounting and Master Data scope. The role protects and evolves the Themis Finance core model by independently challenging and validating functional designs, configuration decisions, integrations, testing and deployment deliverables. It addresses the current internal capability gap by bringing practical SAP Finance deployment expertise into the Product Team, retaining critical knowledge internally and reducing dependency on external experts. This is an L8 role because it requires experienced judgement, autonomy and the authority to validate complex work with global and cross-process impact.







Location | Experience | How to Apply:

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 7-9 Years

How to Apply: Interested candidates can also apply directly via the Infosys Careers Page (https://career.infosys.com/jobdesc?jobReferenceCode=INFSYS-EXTERNAL-254086&rc=0)

Global stakeholder exposure

Opportunity to be part of a large-scale transformation journey

Good to have experience in consumer goods, manufacturing, retail, or related industry domains




Technical Skills Required




Total experience: 7+ years in SAP Finance delivery, functional consulting, Finance transformation or product roles.

Relevant experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience in implementation, integration or deployment projects, including direct involvement in configuration, functional design, testing and go-live activities; prior experience must be sufficient to challenge and validate configuration performed by others.

Education: Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Engineering or a related discipline.

Certifications (if any): SAP FI/CO, SAP S/4HANA, business analysis, product management or Agile certification is an advantage, but not mandatory







Must Have

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience gained through implementation, integration or deployment projects, not only theoretical knowledge or support coordination.

- Strong SAP FI/CO functional and configuration background, with the ability to understand how a solution is configured, assess proposed changes and identify functional or integration risks.

- Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, including Record to Report, financial closing, postings, controls and master-data dependencies.

- Proven ability to review, challenge and validate functional designs, configuration choices

test evidence and deployment deliverables produced by internal or external delivery teams.

- Experience translating complex business requirements into functional solutions and explaining solution constraints, impacts and trade-offs to Finance stakeholders.

- Experience identifying end-to-end dependencies across SAP Finance and integrated modules or applications.

- Ability to work autonomously, make recommendations, escalate material risks and act as a credible bridge between business stakeholders, Product Owners, project teams, AMS and external partners.

- Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, structured problem solving and clear written and verbal communication.




Good to Have

- Deep knowledge of Themis or another global SAP Finance core model.

- Strong Finance Master Data experience, including General Ledger accounts, cost centres, profit centres, organisational structures, governance and distribution.

- SAP S/4HANA or Central Finance exposure.

- Experience with cross-module integration, especially SD, MM, Asset Accounting, Controlling or intercompany flows.

- Experience in global core-model governance, design authority or multi-country deployment environments.

- Business analysis, SAP, product management or Agile certification.




Key Responsibilities




Core responsibilities

- Partner with the squad Product Owner to understand and prioritise business needs across Finance Accounting, Record to Report and Finance Master Data.

- Translate complex business and process requirements into clear functional expectations, user stories, acceptance criteria and validation guardrails.

- Protect the Themis Finance core model by assessing proposed changes against global design principles, harmonisation objectives and long-term product sustainability.

- Challenge and validate functional designs, SAP FI/CO and Master Data solution choices, configuration proposals, integration impacts and test results produced by delivery or AMS teams.

- Provide senior functional guidance on Themis Core model, organisational structures, finance master data, closing and related end-to-end dependencies.

Delivery / operational responsibilities

- Validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements, core-model principles, control expectations and agreed acceptance criteria before release.

- Lead functional impact assessments across processes, company codes, master data, interfaces and connected SAP modules.

- Review defects, incidents and enhancement proposals, identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions rather than local workarounds.

- Support deployment and integration projects through design review, testing strategy, cutover readiness, knowledge transfer and post-go-live stabilisation.

- Maintain decision records and functional documentation so critical Themis and Master Data knowledge remains inside the organisation.




Stakeholder & collaboration responsibilities

- Act as the missing bridge between Finance business stakeholders and technical or configuration teams, ensuring that business intent and SAP implications are understood on both sides.

- Facilitate solution discussions, challenge external partners constructively and communicate decisions, impacts, risks and trade-offs clearly.

- Collaborate with Finance Design Authority, DBS Record to Report and Master Data teams, other Finance Product Teams, Chapter experts, project teams and AMS providers.

- Coach Product Analysts and contribute to stronger internal SAP Finance capability and consistent validation practices.
